publicReleaseNotes: A stopped or detached company can no longer pull decisions. An Oncall linked to a Business now refuses the Business decision relay unless that Business is positively running, and approvals that were still waiting from a stopped or detached Business are refused instead of carried out. One Business's decisions no longer stay visible to a different Business that pairs later; migration 0162 removes only the decision links that provably crossed between Businesses, and every audit record is kept. Erasing a person no longer touches another person's agent records when their addresses are alike. A person whose address merely ends the same way as another's, or whose address extends the erased address with a further domain label, keeps their agent records unchanged; the same holds for identifiers that only begin alike. Erasing a member also removes them from your Business team list and keeps them off it. People erased on earlier versions drop off at your next Business update. Migrations 0161 and 0163 add two small tables, one that remembers which policy references erasure has retired and one that holds value-free markers for retired team members. The pinned rer is now 0.2.107, which refreshes the copied Base runtime. Not covered: restoring an archive made before a teammate's Business link may mark that teammate retired until the Business invites them again, and opaque ids stay in a few audit tables after erasure, as before. No contract status changes in this release. Back up first (this update adds three migrations, 0161-0163), keep applied migrations unchanged, and keep the existing pager active: paging stays OFF.

contractChanges.OC-003: Current CONTRACT.md records done after the cited runtime and member-browser assertions close responder coordination, attributed history and administrator refusal gaps. This release makes no further status change.
contractChanges.OC-004: Current CONTRACT.md records done after the cited runtime and triage assertions close alert links, recovery evidence, resolution summary and human-attributed lifecycle gaps. This release makes no further status change.
contractChanges.SURFACE-001: Agent door code is included, but the current contract still records SURFACE-001 through SURFACE-004 as missing; this release does not promote them.

agentUpdateInstructions: From 0.5.1, back up local data with rer export --output exports/before-0.5.7.rer. For a hosted installation, export its D1 database with npx wrangler d1 export DATABASE --remote --output exports/DATABASE.sql using the original deploying Cloudflare credentials; DATABASE is recorded in .rer/deploy/ENVIRONMENT.json. Keep the backup private. Stop the local app with Ctrl-C, run git pull --ff-only, then rer dev; from a detached release tag use git fetch --tags && git checkout v0.5.7 instead of git pull --ff-only. For a hosted installation, update the original deploying checkout and run rer deploy --environment ENVIRONMENT with the same credentials. The update adds 18 migrations (0146-0163); retain all 67 migration files unchanged and do not reset a populated installation. The checkout pins rer 0.2.107 and installs it through the pinned tooling. Restore only into an empty destination with rer import --input exports/before-0.5.7.rer --yes, then check the owner, schedules, incidents and agent settings. Paging stays OFF; keep the existing pager active. Earlier upgrade instructions follow. From 0.4.2 or from the unreleased v0.5.0 tag, back up local data with rer export --output exports/before-0.5.1.rer. For a hosted installation, export its D1 database with npx wrangler d1 export DATABASE --remote --output exports/DATABASE.sql using the deploying CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN; DATABASE is recorded in .rer/deploy/ENVIRONMENT.json. Keep the backup private. Stop the local app with Ctrl-C, run git pull --ff-only, then rer dev; from a checkout of the v0.5.0 tag run git fetch --tags && git checkout v0.5.1 instead of git pull --ff-only. For a hosted installation, run rer deploy --environment ENVIRONMENT from the original deploying checkout with the same credentials. From 0.4.2 the update applies 15 additive migrations (0129-0137, 0140-0145); from v0.5.0 it applies none. Keep all 49 applied migrations unchanged and do not reset a populated installation. Restore only into an empty destination with rer import --input exports/before-0.5.1.rer --yes, then check the owner, schedules and incidents. The application pins rer exactly to 0.2.71. Paging stays OFF; keep the existing pager active. Earlier upgrade instructions follow. From 0.4.2, back up local data with rer export --output exports/before-0.5.0.rer. For a hosted installation, export its D1 database with npx wrangler d1 export DATABASE --remote --output exports/DATABASE.sql using the deploying CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN; DATABASE is recorded in .rer/deploy/ENVIRONMENT.json. Keep the backup private. Stop the local app with Ctrl-C, run git pull --ff-only, then rer dev; from the hosted checkout run git pull --ff-only then rer deploy --environment ENVIRONMENT with the same credentials. The update applies 15 additive migrations (0129-0137, 0140-0145); keep all 49 applied migrations unchanged and do not reset a populated installation. Restore only into an empty destination with rer import --input exports/before-0.5.0.rer --yes, then check the owner, schedules and incidents. Paging stays OFF; keep the existing pager active. From 0.4.1, back up first with rer export --output exports/before-0.4.2.rer (hosted: export the D1 database with npx wrangler d1 export DATABASE --remote --output exports/DATABASE.sql using the deploying Cloudflare credentials). Stop the local app with Ctrl-C, run git pull --ff-only, then rer dev. For hosted installations, run git pull --ff-only and rer deploy --environment ENVIRONMENT from the original deploying checkout with the same credentials. The update applies one additive migration, 0128_import_door_archive.sql; keep all 34 applied migrations unchanged and do not reset a populated installation. A backup made by 0.4.1 restores into a fresh empty destination with rer import --input exports/before-0.4.2.rer --yes; credentials and sessions do not transfer, and receiving integrations stay inactive until locally authorized. Paging stays OFF; keep the existing pager. Earlier upgrade instructions follow. From 0.4.0, back up first with rer export --output exports/before-0.4.1.rer. Stop the local app with Ctrl-C, run git pull --ff-only, then rer dev. For hosted installations, retain a verified hosted D1 export and private settings, then run git pull --ff-only and rer deploy --environment ENVIRONMENT from the original deploying checkout with the same credentials. Main also carries migration 0127 for installation-local signed-source credential custody; keep every applied migration byte unchanged and do not reset a populated installation. A backup made by the previous version now restores into a fresh empty destination with rer import --input exports/before-0.4.1.rer --yes. Restore retains authored records and import history; credentials and sessions do not transfer, and receiving integrations remain inactive until locally authorized. Paging stays OFF; keep the existing pager. Earlier upgrade instructions follow. To update from 0.3.0, back up first: locally with `rer export --output exports/NAME.rer`; for a hosted installation export its D1 database with `npx wrangler d1 export DATABASE --remote --output exports/DATABASE.sql` (the name is in `.rer/deploy/ENVIRONMENT.json`) using the deploying Cloudflare credentials. Locally, stop `rer dev` with Ctrl-C, run `git pull --ff-only`, then `rer dev`. Hosted, from the checkout that deployed, run `git pull --ff-only` and `rer deploy --environment ENVIRONMENT` with the same credentials; the owner, schedules and incidents are kept. The update applies ten additive migrations (0117-0126); keep all 32 applied migrations unchanged and do not reset to upgrade. Restore a backup only into an empty destination (`rer import --input exports/NAME.rer --yes` locally, a fresh empty installation when hosted). Paging stays OFF; keep your existing pager active. From 0.2.0, stop with `rer dev --stop` and `rer preview --stop`, then run `git pull --ff-only` and `rer dev`. The update applies four additive migrations (0113–0116); keep all 22 applied migrations unchanged and do not reset to upgrade. Data, the owner and password accounts are kept. People who sign in with a workspace password sign in once more, because the held session cookie is now named `oncall_session_<port>`. Captured local sign-in mail is removed with the development outbox; open the app with the `RER_OPEN` link that `rer dev` prints. To update from 0.1.0, stop the old servers before pulling with `node scripts/rer.mjs dev --stop` and `node scripts/rer.mjs preview --stop`, install the global rer command with `curl -fsSL https://runeditrun.com/install.sh | sh` (or `npm install -g @runeditrun/rer`), then run `git pull --ff-only` and `rer dev`. Back up first with `rer export --output exports/NAME.rer` (0.1.0: `node scripts/rer.mjs export --output exports/NAME.rer` while its servers are stopped). Restore only into an empty destination with `rer import --input exports/NAME.rer --yes` after restoring the original private settings. For hosted coordination, follow Install and run → Host for your team: configure remote sign-in mail and run `rer deploy` with your Cloudflare credentials; rer claims the owner and retires the setup token. Open the app address and sign in by emailed link, or with `rer signin`. Update an existing hosted installation with `rer deploy`, preserving its owner and data. Remove with `rer deploy --remove --yes` and confirm its empty readback. Paging stays OFF; keep your existing pager active. Independent standby and paging delivery are outside this release.
